name: 記録前の週間気分グラフ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: Lighthouse LH13-0004「記録前の週間気分グラフ」, one empty weekly mood chart card.
Reference hierarchy: Image 1 ORIGINAL Insight Timer source controls navigation glyph geometry, optical weight, spacing, circular control anatomy and enabled/disabled states. Use its middle Mood Analysis section only. Image 2 our FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for Japanese content and overall chart layout. It contains an error: both chevrons point right and it omits circular control surfaces/disabled state. Correct this from the original, do not copy the rough mock arrows. Image 3 approved Lighthouse bus direction is STYLE ONLY for white rounded surfaces, subtle neutral outlines, soft downward shadows, not map/content.
Design: pure white #FFFFFF canvas and one compact rounded white card. Header「気分の推移」at upper left; next row「今週」at left with two small circular navigation buttons aligned right. Left button has a LEFT-pointing chevron in slate #526173, enabled. Right button has a RIGHT-pointing chevron in light neutral gray #C9CDD0, visibly disabled; both circle surfaces white/near-white with quiet neutral outline, consistent size/stroke and original optical centering. No green selected button and no extra controls.
Below, retain six thin subtle horizontal neutral grid lines and a blank chart area; weekday labels along bottom exactly「月」「火」「水」「木」「金」「土」「日」. Original Thursday label is darker as current day; preserve this with dark ink for「木」and quiet gray for other weekdays. NO points, bars, trend line, zero line, numeric axis values, metric, explanatory message or fabricated history.
Typography: Meiryo Bold 20px/28px heading; Regular 14px/24px period; Regular 12px/16px weekdays, all tracking 0. Main ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E. Compact header spacing, clean baselines, preserve chart's meaningful empty area with evenly spaced grid lines. Logical component 390x365 proportion, full card with modest white margin, no clipping or device mockup.
Accent decision: no chart data and no selected action, so no accent is justified. Keep controls slate/gray and surfaces pure white. Forest-green brand actions are not required here; do not invent a button to use green. Subtle downward card shadow and fine neutral border, quiet rounded shape, no tint/gloss/glow. One static raster candidate, no implication of working controls or editable native data.
reviewNotes: 原画の中央の空グラフを主参照として、モックの左右とも右矢印という誤りを補正。原画どおり左向きの有効・右向きの無効と円形面、木曜の濃い文字を回復。アクセントが不要な空データ状態なので中立色とスレートを採用。結果実見:問い・今週・7曜日・6横線・左/右矢印・無効状態・白面・見切れなし、架空の点/棒/履歴なしを確認。厳密なMeiryo実体と操作実装は未証明。reviewedは画像候補のエージェント視覚レビューで所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
